{{Quote|Yousa doen grand. Jar Jar bringen usen and da Naboo together. So, wesa make you Bombad General.''"<br />"''General??! Oh, no&hellip;|[[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Bombad General''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|high rank]] in the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Since the word ''bombad'' seems to have been a superlative, as in the phrase "Yousa guys bombad!", it seems that this position may have outranked the ordinary [[General/Legends|General]] grade held by senior warriors like [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]], and it may even have been a commander-in-chief position; the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rank of [[Grand General/Legends|Grand General]] may offer a close semantic parallel.

Shortly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the grade of Bombad General was awarded to [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] for his role in uniting the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] against an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], although Jar Jar ended up fainting in shock and horror at the promotion, to Boss Nass's amusement.

==Behind the scenes==
Translated from Gunganese to Basic, the title can be pronounced literally as "[[Superior General]]." In the [[Wikipedia:Swedish (language)|Swedish]] language, ''bombad'' is an adjective meaning "bombed". In slang, it can also be read as "stupid".
